No direct path exists between Site Alpha and Site Beta.  
Furthermore, due to seasonal access restrictions, exactly one of the following two survey routes must be incorporated into the circuit: the path between Beta and Gamma, or the path between Gamma and Delta.  

The objective is to determine the shortest possible closed circuit that visits every site precisely once and returns to the initial site.
